figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 1.  The complete multiple sequence alignment of TmLOX13 proteins sequence with other characterized 
plant LOXs.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 2.  Sequence analysis of TmLOX13 protein. A. The evolutionary history was inferred using the Neighbor-
Joining method. The optimal tree is shown. The percentage of replicate trees in which the associated taxa 
clustered together in the bootstrap test (1000 replicates) are shown next to the branches. This analysis involved 
the top 20 amino acid sequences of plant LOXs that share the highest identity with TmLOX13. Evolutionary 
analyses were conducted in MEGA11. B. The absence of trans-membrane domain (TM) in the protein 
sequence of TmLOX13 compared to an Arabidopsis membrane-associated caleosin (PXG 1) (AEE85247) that 
has been used as a positive control. C. The analysis transmembrane domains was performed using the TM 
finder tool TMHMM 2.0 for prediction of transmembrane helices in proteins.

figure_candidates.label: Table 1
figure_candidates.caption: Table 1.  Enzymatic kinetics of Recombinant TmLOX13 against α-linoleic and α-linolenic acids.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 3.  Characterization of TmLOX13 enzymatic activity. (A) Protein electrophoresis of the recombinant 
TmLOX13 after purification by Ni-affinity chromatography under non-denaturing conditions. (B) The identity 
of this His-tagged protein was further confirmed by immune-detection using anti-His antibodies. (C) the 
peroxidation activity of TmLOX13 was measured against α-linoleic (C18:2) and α-linolenic (C18:3) acids. 
(D) The optimal pH for the enzymatic activity of recombinant TmLOX13 was evaluated over a range of 4.0 
to 9.0 pH at 25 °C and using α-linolenic acid. (E) the optimal temperature corresponding to the best activity 
of TmLOX13 was determined over a range of temperatures from 15 to 60 °C. All measurements were done in 
triplicate. Values are means ± SD (n = 3).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 5
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 5.  Temporal expression and activity of TmLOX13 during both phases of T. media cell suspension cultures. 
A. Transcript quantification of TmLOX13 gene on days 4, 8, 12, 16, 20 and 24 after inoculation (DAI) by RT-
qPCR. For each time point, three measurements were taken in three cDNAs prepared from three individual 
samples. Transcript levels in cells on day 4 were defined as 1, and the corresponding changes in TmLOX13 
transcripts over time points were calculated directly using an AriaMx Real-time PCR System software 
from Agilent Technologies. B. The 13-LOX activity in the cell suspension culture in the same time points 
using α-linolenic as substrate. C. Quantifying of PTX secreted in the medium of T. media. Three separated 
extractions were done and the subsequent analysis of extracted PTX by HPLC was done in triplicate. Data are 
mean values ± SD (n = 9).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 4.  Regioselectivity of TmLOX13. HPLC chromatogram of the hydroperoxides formed from 
both α-linoleic acid (panel A) and α-linolenic acid (panel B) under the action of TmLOX13. The 
13-hydroperoxyoctadecadienoic acid (13-HPOD) (with a retention time of 38.6 min) and the 
13-hydroperoxyoctadeca-9,11,15-trienoic acid (13-HPOT) (with a retention time of 17.2 min) were compared 
to the respective chemical standards (panel C and D, respectively). Three incubations were done for each fatty 
acid and the subsequent analysis of extracted hydroperoxides by HPLC were done in triplicate.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 6
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 6.  Silencing of TmLOX13 gene seriously affects the production of PTX. A. Gene silencing was confirmed 
by quantification of TmLOX13 transcripts in T. media cells treated with siRNA (referred to as siRNATmLOX13) 
or not treated (wt). The color scale (white-green-black) indicates the relative changes of transcript abundance 
of 1, 50 and 100-fold, respectively. Transcripts level in wt cells are considered as 100. B. 13-LOX activity in cell 
suspension cultures treated with siRNAs or not treated (wt) using α-linolenic as substrate. C. The biomass, 
expressed as gram of fresh weight per 100 mL of cell suspension cultures in both siRNATmLOX13 and wt cells. 
D. The amount of secreted PTX in the medium of T. media cells treated with siRNA or not treated (wt). E. 
HPLC diagrams of PTX extracted from Wt cell suspension as well as from TmLOX13-silenced cell suspension 
compared to standard PTX. F. Transcript quantification of key genes involved in PTX biosynthesis (TXS, 
DBAT and DBTNBT) in both T. media cells treated with siRNA or not treated (wt) on days 8, 12, 16, 20 and 24 
after inoculation (DAI). For each time point, three measurements were taken in three cDNAs prepared from 
three individual samples. The color scale (black-red-white-green-black) indicates relative changes of transcript 
abundance from − 20 to + 20-fold. All measurements were performed in triplicate. Presented data are mean 
values ± SD (n = 9). Statistical significance was evaluated by ANOVA analysis. Asterisks indicate significant 
differences between treated samples and their respective control samples (*P < 0.05).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 7
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 7.  Inhibition of TmLOX13 enzymatic activity dramatically affects the production of PTX. A. The 
inhibitory effect of nordihydroguaiaretic acid (NDGA) on purified recombinant TmLOX13. The enzyme was 
pre-incubated with 1 mM of NDGA for 5 min at 25 °C (sample referred to as + NDGA). Then, the activity was 
assayed using 0.5 mM of linolenic (C18:3) acids in optimal reaction conditions. B. The amount of secreted 
PTX in the medium of T. media cells pre-treated with inhibitor (+ NDGA) or not treated (-NDGA). C. Relative 
expression of key genes involved in PTX biosynthesis (TXS, DBAT and DBTNBT) in both T. media cells pre-
treated with inhibitor (+ NDGA) or not treated (-NDGA) on days 8, 12, 16, 20 and 24 after inoculation (DAI). 
The color scale (black-red-white-green-black) indicates the relative changes of transcript abundance from 
− 20 to + 20-fold. All measurements were performed in triplicate. Data are mean values ± SD (n = 3). Statistical 
significance was evaluated by ANOVA analysis. Asterisks indicate significant differences between treated 
samples (+ NDGA) and their respective control samples (-NDGA) (*P < 0.05).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 8
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 8.  Exogenous treatment with Jasmonic acid effectively stimulates the production of PTX. A. The level of 
JA in the TmLOX13-silenced cells compared to control cells. B. The amount of secreted PTX in the medium 
of TmLOX13-silenced cells treated with 100 µM of JA compared to non-treated. C. Relative expression of key 
genes involved in PTX biosynthesis (TXS, DBAT and DBTNBT) in both TmLOX13-silenced cells treated with 
100 µM of JA compared to non-treated on days 8, 12, 16, 20 and 24 after inoculation (DAI). The color scale 
(black-red-white-green-black) indicates the relative changes of transcript abundance from − 20 to + 20-fold. 
All measurements were performed in triplicate. Data are mean values ± SD (n = 3). Statistical significance was 
evaluated by ANOVA analysis. Asterisks indicate significant differences between JA-treated samples and their 
respective control samples (*P < 0.05).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 9
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 9.  Complementation of TmLOX13-silenced cells with 13-LOX/PXG-pathway-derived oxylipins. A. The 
amount of secreted PTX in the medium of TmLOX13-silenced cells complemented or not with an ethanol 
solution of 100 µM of 13-HOT or a mix of epoxides (Mix-EOE) or a mix of dihydroxys (Mix-DHOE) on days 
16 and 20 after inoculation (DAI). B. Relative expression of TXS, DBAT and DBTNBT in TmLOX13- silenced 
cells complemented or not with 13-HOT or Mix-EOE or Mix-DHOE on days 16 and 20. The color scale 
(black-red-white-green-black) indicates the relative changes of transcript abundance from − 20 to + 20-fold. 
All measurements were performed in triplicate. Presented data are values ± SD (n = 3). Statistical significance 
was evaluated by ANOVA analysis. Asterisks indicate significant differences between TmLOX13-silenced cells 
complemented with oxylipins or not (*P < 0.05).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 10
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 10.  A schematic pathway of plant 13-LOX- mediated oxylipins biosynthesis. Particularly, derivatives 
oxylipins from the 13-LOX/PXG pathway were presented.
